item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0020-E001","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Juan Ramón de la Fuente of Mexico served as President of the second Meeting of States Parties to the Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons, which adopted its report, a declaration rejecting threats to use nuclear weapons, and decisions extending intersessional work, adopting reporting guidance, holding discussions on victim assistance and environmental remediation, and establishing consultations on security concerns.","notes":["The excerpt supports Mexico’s representative serving as President and the Meeting’s collective adoption of these outcomes, but does not establish that de la Fuente personally caused or directed their adoption."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0020-E002","status":"rejected","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt supports the 13–14 July 2023 Nuclear Suppliers Group plenary, its chair from Argentina, the agreed list updates, responsible supplier behavior and export-control discussion, and Brazil’s subsequent chairmanship.","It does not mention Mexico or establish Mexican participation, so the proposed Mexico attribution is unsupported."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0020-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt directly supports the Austria-Ireland-Mexico working paper, the Conference’s welcome for continued discussion of the Guiding Principles, human rights and international humanitarian law, the Diversion Information Exchange Forum, and concern about low reporting compliance."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0020-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt directly supports OPANAL’s Mexico City summer school, its co-organizers, the dates, and attendance by 31 diplomats from 27 regional countries.","It also supports OPANAL’s 2023 commemorative communications and General Conference."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0020-E005","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Mexico chaired the Consultative Committee of the Inter-American Convention against the Illicit Manufacturing of and Trafficking in Firearms, Ammunition, Explosives and Other Related Materials at its twenty-third regular meeting. Brazil, Chile and Mexico conducted an OAS-supported peer-review exercise in Mexico City in September 2023 on implementation of Security Council resolution 1540, focused on biological-weapons non-proliferation. The Inter-American Committee supported eight countries in strengthening biosafety and biosecurity measures.","notes":["The excerpt supports Mexico’s chairmanship and participation in the peer-review exercise.","The excerpt does not identify Mexico as one of the eight countries receiving biosafety and biosecurity support, so that attribution was narrowed out."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0020-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt directly supports the 1540 Committee’s review of its assistance mechanism, Mexico’s update of its previously submitted assistance request, and the Brazil-Chile-Mexico peer-review exercise held in Mexico City on 28–29 September 2023."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0020-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt directly supports the Meeting’s appointment of Mexico as gender focal point for the following intersessional period and the described gender-related discussions concerning participation, victim assistance, environmental remediation, cooperation and assistance, and disaggregated evidence-based data."]}]}
